text:
Lena: quick morale drop — Hugo (dachshund) discovered Penelope (hedgehog) in the blanket fort. photo: HUGO_PENELOPE_1.jpg
Marcus: instant cottagecore. also: who made the fort? :laughing:
Lena: 3am boredom. I used two chairs and a towel. Penelope is unimpressed, Hugo thinks it's a tunnel to Narnia.
Tasha: we need video evidence. hedgehog + sausage dog content is a public service.
Lena: uploading `fort_recon.mp4` — 7s, 9MB (Hugo sniffs, Penelope squeaks, then both fall asleep)
Ravi: that sound at 00:03 is pure office ASMR. saving this for rainy day playlist.
PipBot: reaction added :heart: by Tasha
Marcus: poll: should we make "Pet Fort Friday" a thing? 1) yes 2) monthly special 3) never speak of this again
Tasha: 1 pls.
Ravi: 2 so it remains special but not overwhelming.
Lena: also posting the close-up snooze pic HUGO_PENELOPE_2.jpg :zzz:
Marcus: choose a caption: a) "Tiny roommates, giant naps" b) "Fortune favors the cozy" c) "I paid rent in treats"
Tasha: a)
Lena: nailed it. thanks team. bedtime for the fort creche. :dog::hedgehog:
